parts:
Rémi,

I'm not sure what is going on, especially because the summary() output says "lavaan" at the top instead of "blavaan". But my first thought would be to remove all the list() and NULL arguments. So you would be left with something like

fitmodel <- bsem(modelbayes, data=afmatreduit, convergence = "auto")

Maybe that will help.

Ed

parts:
Hi again,

In the litterature, I found issues regarding residual covariances, and that these ones should be included in the model.
So, I used modification indices in lavann and noticed that there are some residual covariances in my model.
As done in the lavann example "Political Democracy", I included these ones, and the fit in lavaan increased, increasing the PPP in blavaan.

In my previous msg, the problem with blavaan is that it doest like "satisfaction =~ 1*satis", but I do not know how to specify a single item variable (so I used it as manifest).

I will post my results tonight in order to have your kind comments on my model fit

Thanhs !

Rémi

Rémi,

If you could send data from your model with "satisfaction =~ 1*satis", that would be helpful. It seems like you might obtain the same model by treating satis as manifest, but I'm not certain.

Ed

Best,
